purpose: Classify legacy integrity/governance controls before consolidation so useful protections are preserved, redundant governance is removed from the active path, and unresolved risks remain explicit.

classification_rules.CONSTITUTION_KEEP: Control directly prevents leakage, silent sample mutation, invalid temporal inference, OOS/prospective contamination, unauthorized model-rule change, material evidence identity failure, or risk-discipline failure.
classification_rules.ACTIVE_COMPATIBILITY_KEEP: Control is not needed for new V2.9 architecture but remains required to interpret or close an already-active frozen historical contract such as V2.8.12R.
classification_rules.DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: Useful for debugging or observability but failure must not block research unless escalation criteria in the kernel are met.
classification_rules.REDUNDANT_RETIRE_FROM_ACTIVE_PATH: Another retained control already prevents the same system-critical failure with equal or stronger coverage and no unique historical binding.
classification_rules.UNRESOLVED_BLOCKER: A real system-critical failure remains possible and no retained control currently closes it.

retirement_safety.retire_means: Remove from future active decision path or mark diagnostic-only; preserve historical artifacts for provenance.

exit_condition: Audit is complete only when every active integrity/governance control is classified and no UNRESOLVED_BLOCKER remains unowned.
